title: Answer to a decomposition question on tori raised by Colliot-Thélène and Sansuc
summary: The aim of this note is to present a simple strategy to answer negatively a decomposition question on tori posed by Colliot-Thélène and Sansuc in the article \textit{Principal Homogeneous Spaces under Flasque Tori: Applications} of 1987. We then deduce a torus $T$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ and a prime number $p$ such that $T(\mathbb{Z}_p)\,T(\mathbb{Q})\not=T(\mathbb{Q}_p)$, where $T(\mathbb{Z}_p)$ denotes the maximal compact subgroup of $T(\mathbb{Q}_p)$.
